name: Log Viewer
description: Open large log files, filter by level, text or regex, and follow new lines as they are written
help: Open a log file of any size, or drop it onto the window. Lines are indexed in Rust (about 1 GB per second) and only the visible part is read, so gigabyte logs open quickly.
Levels are detected from common formats: plain text (ERROR, WARN, INFO…), [error], level=warn, JSON logs and numeric pino levels. Stack trace lines inherit the level of the line above.
Type to filter lines, turn on Aa for case-sensitive matching or .* for regular expressions, and click the level chips to show only those levels. Matches are highlighted.
Turn on Follow to watch the file like tail -f: new lines appear every second and the view stays at the end. Scroll up to pause following. Truncated or rotated files are re-indexed automatically.
Click a line to see the full text; JSON inside the line is formatted in the side panel.
UTF-8 and GB18030 (GBK) logs are detected automatically; color codes are removed.
